text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Trainer... It's over.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I believe I was able to 
demonstrate my true ability.

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Cheers from outside...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Oguri, you were amazing!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It might be tough distance-wise, but... I 
wanna see Oguri at the end of the year, 
too~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...It seems everyone has high expectations 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I really want to run in it... the 'Arima 
Kinen'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap was raring to go. And good news 
was waiting for her.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —...! I can run in the Arima Kinen!?
choice_data_list:
If we keep this up, you can definitely 
enter!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether checking voluntary online polls or 
the predictions of various newspapers, 
Oguri Cap's name was always there!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... So everyone really is placing 
their hopes on me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Their cheers give me strength. Right 
now... I don't feel like I can lose!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The heat of the crowd, Oguri Cap's 
feelings, and my own... are all peaking at 
this very moment.
choice_data_list: The Arima Kinen is finally here!
The Arima Kinen is finally here!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Let us challenge it. ...To the stage 
of our dreams!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way home from the race—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Phew... phew... One more lap...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on... Hold on a second, Creek! 
Let's take a quick breather!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Passion is fine and all, but you're 
pushing yourself way too hard! That ain't 
like you at all!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, are you worried about me~? There, 
there, Inari-chan, good girl, good girl♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh! Don't dodge the question! It's 
because of the summer training camp, isn't 
it?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that race you ran with Oguri, 
haven't you seemed weirdly impatient?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
......I couldn't pass her. I couldn't pass 
Oguri-chan.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"If it turns into a battle of pure 
explosive power against Ogri-chan like 
this... I'll lose."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to get pulled into their 
element. To make sure that doesn't happen, 
I need to build up more stamina.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Creek... Why do you go so far for 
Oguri...?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
—I can't lose. Because... If I'm not 
strong, I can't support everyone.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Stronger than anyone, more dependable than 
anyone... That's who I want to be!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So... that's why I have to get stronger. 
Much stronger... than Oguri-chan!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Aaalright, fine! Not when you're all 
fired up like that!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"I won't stop you anymore. In return, I'm 
bringing you water, so drink it!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Inari-chan. You really are 
such a good girl――

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ――Ah.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, Oguri-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly, you had a race 
today, right? Thank you for your hard 
work.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah...... Thank you. ......

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter which fan poll results for the 
Arima Kinen I looked at, Super Creek's 
name was always there. Finally, the two of 
them will...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm so looking forward to the 'Arima 
Kinen'~. I'd be thrilled if I get to race 
with Oguri-chan again."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I couldn't win at the summer 
training camp, but... this time, I'm going 
to beat you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so? Let's both do our best.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Just one thing, though…… I have no 
intention of losing either.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Allow me to defeat you at your 
absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ Well then, I'll be continuing my 
training~

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Creek is giving it her all, too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There's not much time left until the Arima 
Kinen, but... I want to do whatever I can 
too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Trainer, lend me your strength!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The day of the decisive battle is near. 
Seeing that renewed my determination to 
make Oguri Cap win!
